description: This file contains unit tests for the MediaPipeline component, specifically testing the 'haveData' functionality in various scenarios including success, failure, and edge cases. It uses Google Test framework and mocks dependencies such as the media pipeline, timer, shared memory buffer, and media source requests.

classes.name: RialtoServerMediaPipelineHaveDataTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing the 'haveData' method of the media pipeline, setting up mocks and common test data.

methods.name: CommonHaveDataFailureDueToUninitializedPlayer
methods.description: Tests that 'haveData' returns false when the media pipeline is uninitialized.

methods.name: CommonHaveDataSuccessWithUnknownRequestId
methods.description: Tests that 'haveData' returns true when the request type is UNKNOWN.

methods.name: CommonHaveDataSuccessWithSchedulingNeedMediaDataResend
methods.description: Tests that 'haveData' schedules a resend timer when the request type is VIDEO and status is ERROR.

methods.name: CommonHaveDataGettingSamplesThrows
methods.description: Tests that 'haveData' handles exceptions thrown when getting segments.

methods.name: CommonHaveDataSuccess
methods.description: Tests successful 'haveData' processing for a VIDEO source.

methods.name: CommonHaveDataSuccessEos
methods.description: Tests 'haveData' handling End Of Stream (EOS) status for a VIDEO source.

methods.name: AddSegmentReturnsError
methods.description: Tests that adding a segment returns ERROR status.

methods.name: AddSegmentReturnsNoSpace
methods.description: Tests that adding a segment returns NO_SPACE status.

methods.name: AddSegmentSuccess
methods.description: Tests successful addition of a segment.

methods.name: ServerInternalHaveDataFailureDueToUninitializedPlayer
methods.description: Tests 'haveData' returns false when called with internal server API and uninitialized player.

methods.name: ServerInternalHaveDataSuccessWithUnknownRequestId
methods.description: Tests 'haveData' returns true for internal API with UNKNOWN request type.

methods.name: ServerInternalHaveDataSuccessWithSchedulingNeedMediaDataResend
methods.description: Tests scheduling of media data resend in internal API scenario.

methods.name: ServerInternalHaveDataSuccessWithSkipSchedulingNeedMediaDataResendTwice
methods.description: Tests handling multiple resend scheduling for internal API.

methods.name: ServerInternalHaveDataSuccessWithResendingScheduledNeedMediaDataSuccess
methods.description: Tests successful resending of media data with callback invocation.

methods.name: ServerInternalHaveDataFailureDueToShmBufferError
methods.description: Tests 'haveData' failure when shared memory buffer is invalid.

methods.name: ServerInternalHaveDataFailureDueToInvalidBufferOffset
methods.description: Tests 'haveData' failure when buffer offset retrieval throws an exception.

methods.name: ServerInternalHaveDataFailureDueToUnsupportedMetadataVersion
methods.description: Tests 'haveData' failure when metadata version is unsupported.

methods.name: ServerInternalHaveDataSuccess
methods.description: Tests successful 'haveData' processing for internal API with valid data.

methods.name: ServerInternalHaveDataAudioSuccess
methods.description: Tests successful 'haveData' processing for audio source.

methods.name: ServerInternalHaveDataSuccessWithEos
methods.description: Tests 'haveData' handling EOS status for internal API.

methods.name: ServerInternalHaveDataSuccessEosWithoutFrames
methods.description: Tests EOS handling when no frames are provided.
